propositions: tests/unit/test_build_provenance.py independently rebuilds identical clean-source artifacts three times per test session, causing the module to take 35.93s when the prerequisite work is duplicated.

A session-scoped per-worker immutable fixture that builds wheel and sdist once with REBAR_BUILD_COMMIT=abc1234 and exposes read-only artifact paths eliminates duplicate prerequisite builds while preserving distinct wheel-from-sdist, empty-env failure, sdist-content, and rebuild-from-sdist coverage.

Function-scoped consumers extract/rebuild locally from the shared artifacts, preventing mutation of shared state and allowing install-from-sdist and empty-env failure to retain their own real build boundaries.

Deterministic build-call counting via a held-out subprocess oracle confirms exactly one successful prerequisite build per pytest worker/session; seeded defects (duplicate build or missing COMMIT) fail the oracle and provenance assertions respectively.
